summary.name: PDF Expert
summary.one_liner: PDF Expert is a PDF editor and reader for iPhone, iPad and Mac that covers editing, annotation, signing, conversion and page organization.
use_cases: edit text and images in a PDF
convert PDF to Word or Excel
fill out tax or insurance forms
annotate and review documents with audio notes and stamps
summary.what_it_does: The page describes PDF Expert as a tool for editing PDF text, images, links, signatures, pages and files. It supports signing documents with an electronic signature and collecting customer signatures on iPhone and iPad. It converts PDFs to Word, Excel, PowerPoint and JPG, and offers form filling with formulas and calculations. It also provides OCR for scanned documents and an AI-powered "Enhance" feature that fixes distortions, removes shadows and improves contrast, plus a set of annotation tools such as highlighters, stamps, stickers and audio notes.
notable: AI-powered Enhance feature for cleaning up scanned PDFs
Single account syncs across iPhone, iPad and Mac, with Pencil and Magic Keyboard support on iPad
Part of Readdle's app family (Spark, Scanner Pro, Documents, Calendars)
caveats: Page only offers a free trial; full pricing and paid tier details are not stated on the page
